$comment: Single source of truth for the shop taxonomy. Read by the Next.js frontend (frontend/lib/catalog/normalize.mjs) AND the Python scraper (backend/scraper/taxonomy.py). Assignment is scored: a keyword hit inside the first 45 characters of the title counts 3, a later hit counts 1; highest score wins, ties are broken by ascending `order`. The entry with "fallback": true catches products without any hit. `search_queries` and `amazon_bestseller_category` drive what the scraper fetches, so every category can actually be filled.
